description: This file contains unit tests for the CookieClearingFilter class in a Java web application, testing the behavior of cookie clearing under different session scenarios.

classes.name: CookieClearingFilterTest
classes.description: Junit test class for testing CookieClearingFilter behavior in various session and cookie scenarios.

methods.name: setupRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Initializes the runtime properties for testing environment.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test objects such as the filter, session, request, response, and chain.

methods.name: shouldClearCookiesIfSessionEnded
methods.description: Tests that cookies are cleared when the session is invalidated.

methods.name: shouldNotClearCookiesIfSessionNotInvalidated
methods.description: Verifies that cookies are not cleared if the session remains valid.

methods.name: shouldNotClearCookiesIfNewSessionCreatedButNotInvalidated
methods.description: Checks that new sessions not invalidated do not trigger cookie clearing.

methods.name: shouldNotClearCookiesIfNewSessionCreatedAndInvalidatedInOneRequest
methods.description: Ensures cookies are not cleared if a new session is created and invalidated within the same request.

methods.name: shouldClearAllConfiguredCookies
methods.description: Verifies that specified cookies are cleared based on configuration.

methods.name: shouldClearAllConfiguredCookiesIgnoringWhitespace
methods.description: Checks that cookie clearing configuration ignores whitespace and tabs.

methods.name: clearJSessionIdOnLogout
methods.description: Helper to set the property for clearing JSESSIONID cookie.

methods.name: createChainThatInvalidatesSession
methods.description: Helper to create a filter chain that invalidates session for testing.

methods.name: createSessionWithId
methods.description: Helper to create a session with a specific ID and session state (new or not).

methods.name: SessionInvalidationServlet
methods.description: Inner class used to invalidate session in tests.
